question: Can held-out reference prediction choose a mapping score without the generated family label?
outcome: Across 48 fresh systems and 384 conditions, the selector recovers 309 maps versus fixed graph 283, fixed slot 168 and supplied-family diagnostic 310. Twenty-symbol administrative gain over graph is 26.04 points, interval 14.58–38.54. All 96 reference choices and 1,536 returned-map scores independently checked; 6,489 checks pass. Eleven slot-tie conditions have 32 exact alternative likelihood witnesses.
challenge: Graph end probabilities and slot likelihoods initially describe different length spaces; small references can select a weaker mapping model. A NumPy boolean caused pilot serialization failure.
remedy: Condition both likelihoods on observed length using an exact graph normalizer, choose before truth evaluation, retain both fixed methods and the supplied-family diagnostic. Preserve failed pilot and repeat only its boolean serialization repair in a new endpoint. Certify tied alternatives separately.
retry_when: Shared-length forms, overlapping inventories, uncertain segmentation or an independently acquired reference changes the observation problem.
